feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 15 November 2026 4:00pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Sunday, 15 November 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry this evening and at first tonight, with clear spells developing as winds gradually ease.

Clear spells, with a slight frost in places around dawn and a small risk of icy patches. Minimum temperature 0°C on higher ground and in the central valley.

Sunny spells during the daytime, then cloud thickens through the evening with a band of rain arriving around midnight, falling as snow on hills. Fresh northwest winds become light and variable for a time during the day, before becoming easterly in the afternoon, then increasing strong to gale force later in evening. Top temperature of 8°C.


##Outlook##

Rain continuing through the night into Tuesday, turning heavy at times, and initially wintry on higher ground before temperatures rise. Minimum temperature 1°C .

The persistent band of rain clears in the morning, though intermittent spells of rain continue for much of the day. Strong to gale force east winds gradually easing. Top temperature 10°C.

7:47am Tomorrow

4:17pm Tomorrow
